Independent algebra and direct finite reproduction
correctness.rationale: The append step partitions descendants into those retaining and omitting the new last symbol; the intersection consists of one-deletion descendants ending in that symbol. Counting those by whether the last run repeats, lengthens, or forms a return gives the increment of binom(R,2)+S-T. At n=2 the count is one. The transfer records a change, start of a long run, and return, using only whether the preceding edge changed. The count q(q-1)^k over each fixed edge pattern proves iid Bernoulli change indicators. At each successive double change, exactly one of q-1 equiprobable choices is a return, even after conditioning on the entire edge pattern and earlier returns. Centering in these independent edge indicators gives the linear coefficient p(m-1) and quadratic coefficients -1/(q-1) for adjacent indices and 1 otherwise. Orthogonality and conditional binomial variance yield the stated polynomial. For the mean, a fixed output of length n-2 is contained with the probability of at least n-2 successes in n Bernoulli(1/q) trials, by greedy matching (continue against dummy symbols after a full match). The linear Bernoulli CLT and lower-order residuals give the fixed-q Gaussian, without relying on finite experiments. Fresh literal deletion-set histograms, the transfer and both exact moments agreed for q=2,3,4,5 through lengths 9,7,6,5 respectively, including the stated q=3,n=5 histogram. Replay: python /tmp/opencode/frozen_review_reproduce.py deletion.
